ios.desc:
Think your food deserves a 10/10?

Rate My Food is the social food-rating app where AI and real food lovers come together to rate, review, and discover great food.

Upload a photo of your breakfast, lunch, dinner, takeaway, dessert, meal prep, barbecue, healthy creation, or family favourite and get an instant review from Chef Eleanorish, your AI food critic. Chef Eleanorish analyses presentation, creativity, freshness, balance, portion size, and overall appeal, providing helpful feedback and a score for every dish.

Then the community takes over.

Share your food, collect ratings, receive feedback, climb the leaderboards, and discover what food lovers really think. Whether you're posting a home-cooked masterpiece or tonight's quick dinner, every plate has a chance to become a community favourite.

Browse meals from around the world, discover new recipes and cooking ideas, follow other food enthusiasts, and explore trending dishes that are capturing attention across the community.

Rate dishes using simple reactions including Love It, Like It, Okay, and Needs Work. Every rating helps highlight great food, inspire fellow cooks, and showcase creativity in the kitchen.

Build your own food profile, track your highest-rated meals, grow your following, and create a personal collection of dishes you're proud to share.

Features include instant AI food reviews, community ratings, trending dishes, food leaderboards, creator profiles, comments, food discovery, personalised feedback, content moderation, reporting tools, and a safe community designed for food lovers.

Whether you're a passionate home cook, baker, meal prep enthusiast, foodie, restaurant lover, or simply someone who enjoys sharing great meals, Rate My Food gives every dish the audience it deserves.

Download Rate My Food today and see what food lovers think of your next creation.

Disclaimer: Rate My Food is designed for food discovery, entertainment, creativity, and community participation. AI reviews, ratings, comments, and reactions are automated and community-driven and should not be considered professional culinary, nutritional, dietary, or health advice. Respectful participation is encouraged at all times.
